parameters.command: =timeout 60 docker exec ffuf sh -c 'ffuf -u "{{ $json.endpoint }}?{{ $json.param }}=FUZZ" -w {{ $json.wordlist }} -mc all -t 100 -k -enc "FUZZ:urlencode" -o "{{ $json.ffufOut }}" -of json -s > /dev/null 2>&1'; echo "EXIT=$?"
=timeout 60 docker exec wfuzz sh -c 'wfuzz -z file,{{ $json.wordlist }},urlencode -u "{{ $json.endpoint }}?{{ $json.param }}=FUZZ" -t 100 -f "{{ $json.wfuzzOut }}" > /dev/null 2>&1'; echo "EXIT=$?"
